ValidationRule.description: This Validation rule will not allow create/update on Program Rebate Type once the Rebate program is Inactive.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c ) , OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ) , 'Inactive'), ISNEW() ), ISPICKVAL( RebateProgram.Status , 'Inactive') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot create/update Program Rebate Type once Rebate Program is Inactive
